title: admin_risk_register v3.0 (post-v7.0.12)
description: Schema for pipeline/institutional_memory/admin_risk_register.yaml after architecture v7.0.12 (LOCKED 2026-05-16T14:00:00Z) retires the four-axis political enum. Forbids progressive_register, requires per_clc_register keyed by the 8 CapitalLogicCard slugs. See pipeline/architecture/v0.1/architecture_v7_0_12_apolitical_dialect_amendment.md §1.2.

version.description: Register version. v7.0.12 mandates v3.0 or higher (v2.x carried the retired progressive_register field).

expansion_cycles.description: Taxonomic-history block describing how the register grew. Per architecture v7.0.12 §1.1 excluded-paths list, this block may legitimately reference the retired four-axis vocabulary factually as audit history.

capital_logic_card_slug.description: Canonical CapitalLogicCard slug from pipeline/types/identity_capital.py (closed set of 8 per v7.0.8).

register_value.description: Per-CLC dialect-register acceptability. Defaults to AVOID for any CLC not listed in per_clc_register; the empty map {} means AVOID-everywhere.

term.description: Flagged term as it appears in candidate proposal text.

severity.description: Federal admin-risk tier per Law 4 register discipline. RED = documented denial/termination. YELLOW = memo/leaked-list/scrutiny signal. GREEN = precautionary; sector-dependent.

per_clc_register.description: Per-CLC dialect-register map. Architecture v7.0.12 §1.2: any CLC not listed defaults to AVOID; empty map = AVOID-everywhere (the safest unmigrated default). Operator promotes individual entries to OK/EXPECTED/PREFERRED based on actual reviewer-vocabulary analysis.

_pre_v7_0_12_progressive_register_PRESER.description: Audit-context-only preservation of the retired v2.x progressive_register value. NEVER read by routing code. Provided as operator reference during the v7.0.12 per-term audit so the operator can see what the prior axis was without it influencing the new per_clc_register decision (per FI-7 REVISED + feedback_no_heuristic_mapping_on_enum_retirement.md). MAY be deleted after the operator completes the per-term audit.
